# has member

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasMember`](gmeow-hasMember.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasMember>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an organization to one of its member agents; the inverse of [`gmeow:memberOf`](gmeow-memberOf.md). Non-functional — an organization has many members.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when traversing or projecting from an organization to its members — the whole-rooted direction where stating the organization first is natural.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting [`gmeow:hasMember`](gmeow-hasMember.md) directly when the member's perspective is the natural one — assert [`gmeow:memberOf`](gmeow-memberOf.md) and read [`gmeow:hasMember`](gmeow-hasMember.md) as its inverse — and avoid it where role or period matter (use a [`gmeow:Membership`](../classes/gmeow-Membership.md)).

### How to use

- Prefer asserting [`gmeow:memberOf`](gmeow-memberOf.md) and let [`gmeow:hasMember`](gmeow-hasMember.md) follow by inversion; reach for it explicitly only in organization-rooted projections.
